_strategyNote: MUST be called after POST /bots to force MCS to materialize the GptComponent from the bot's configuration. Without this call, the bot exists but has no orchestrator (user sees empty agent).

requiredFields.constraint: array of component kinds to materialize (typically ['BotEntity'])

responseShape: HTTP 200 (no body used by our code) — side effect is that subsequent component-sync reads will find the new components
knownQuirks: If not called after POST /bots, the GptComponent is never materialized — agent is a shell. This is the #1 build-pipeline gotcha.
PVA token (different AAD resource than Dataverse) — build-pipeline must acquire both tokens.
api-version is required; 2022-03-01-preview has been stable since discovery.
nonContractualFields: $.Kind[] values beyond 'BotEntity' (other kinds exist but we don't use them)

errorCases.reason: Wrong token audience — uses PVA not Dataverse
Bot GUID not found in PVA
